name: Kalnama AI Search
author: jazxinnovation

sections.description:
Kalnama AI Search provides local, API-free intelligent search for WordPress.

Core release features include:

  • Urdu-first multilingual search.
  • Support for public WordPress post types and public taxonomies.
  • Generic Index v2 for searchable WordPress content.
  • Local Ranking v3.1.
  • Local Alias Intelligence and query expansion.
  • Browser-based voice search where supported.
  • Automatic indexing and full reindex tools.
  • Admin dashboard, diagnostics, settings and logs.
  • No external AI API key required.
  • No per-query AI API charges.

The core search, indexing, ranking and alias intelligence run locally with WordPress/PHP/database data.
sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate Kalnama AI Search.
  2. Open Kalnama AI Search in the WordPress admin area.
  3. Review Search Settings and language options.
  4. Build or rebuild the search index.
  5. Test text and voice search on the frontend.
sections.faq:
Does the core plugin require an external AI API key?

No. Version 1.0.4 uses an API-free local search architecture.

What is the default primary language?

Urdu is the default primary language. Multilingual search can also be enabled for additional supported language profiles.

Does voice search send audio to an external AI provider?

Kalnama AI Search uses the browser’s supported speech-recognition capability for voice input. The plugin’s core search engine itself does not require an external AI API.
